optimization: Borrow maintained chunk-ID indexes in RAG candidate/traversal lookups and induced-edge validation instead of constructing two corpus-wide per-query hash maps.
baseline: Same working tree immediately before this isolated optimization; includes previous uncommitted v0.10 work.

method.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95 of all 150 samples per variant/workload/size. Each process rebuilds identical deterministic data; before/after use the same harness and release toolchain.
method.parity: Complete canonical JSON is byte-identical across all variants and repetitions for each size; only lexical_cache_hit telemetry is omitted. All measured queries assert a warm lexical cache.

scope: Synthetic 128-dimensional vectors, 10 chunks per document, adjacent graph links and no semantic link generation. Measures warm in-process retrieval plus MMR; excludes setup, warm-up, result serialization, HTTP, external providers and concurrent load. One-document filter admits 10 chunks. Local measurements are not throughput, answer-quality or general database claims.
